Is it really free?
Yes. Playing is free and there is nothing to buy on the site. Short ads inside the games pay the developers and the site.
Do I need to make an account?
No. There is no account, no sign-up and no newsletter. You open a game and play.
Do I have to download or install anything?
No. All the games run in your browser and start instantly, with no download and no installs.
Can I play on my phone or tablet?

Yes, for many games. Lots of them are made for touch and are collected in the Mobile category, and games built for a wide screen ask you to turn the phone sideways. A few older games need a keyboard and mouse, and they say so on their page.
Is it safe for my children?
We only allow family-friendly games: no adult content, no gambling and no hate. Games for younger players are in the Kids category.
Will my progress and favourites be saved?

Yes, but only in your own browser. Your recently played games, favourites and light or dark choice never leave your device, and most games save their own progress the same way. If you clear your browser data or play in private mode, they are lost.
A game will not load. What can I do?

We can't promise a fix from here, but if it keeps failing, email us at contact@ilovewebgames.com and tell us which game it is. Some older games also need a keyboard and mouse, which is noted on their page.
Where do the games come from?

Six games are made by Door 404, our own studio. The rest are licensed from the distribution networks Playgama, GameMonetize and GamePix, plus 20 games sent in directly by independent developers. We never copy games from other portals.
How do I submit my own game?
Go to https://ilovewebgames.com/submit-game/. It is free and non-exclusive, and a real person plays every submission. An accepted game gets its own page that credits you and links back to you.
How do I get my game removed?
Email us at contact@ilovewebgames.com and we will take it down. Your game stays hosted on your own server, and you can ask for removal at any time.
Can I embed a game on my own website?
Only the games made by Door 404. Their pages have an "Embed this game" box with ready-made code. Games from other developers are not ours to licence, so we can't offer embed code for them.
How do I reach a real person?
Write to contact@ilovewebgames.com. The site is run by Door 404, an escape room and game studio from Novi Sad, Serbia.
